event.text: You can manage this at home for now: wash the area and any gardening clothes, avoid further contact with the plant, and use a cool compress or over-the-counter anti-itch or antihistamine measures. This pattern fits a localized skin reaction to something you touched. Message Counsel or seek care if the rash spreads, blisters or weeps, becomes painful, warm or swollen, or if you develop fever, facial or lip swelling, or trouble breathing.
